metadata.climate_summary: Hot late dry → habagat onset, 28-34°C, humidity 75-90%, afternoon thunderstorms possible by end May/early Jun
metadata.power_plug: Type A/B/C (220V/60Hz). US 2-pin (Type A) fits — SG/UK Type G plugs DO NOT fit (need adaptor).
metadata.tap_water: NOT potable. Bottled only — even at most hotels. Boil if cooking.
metadata.tipping: Service charge 10% often auto-added; if not, leave 5-10% for sit-down. Grab driver round up. Spa ₱50-100.

risk_flags: Habagat onset
Late May / early Jun = start of SW monsoon. Afternoon thunderstorms 30-40% days. Pack rain shell + dry-bag for electronics.
NAIA traffic
EDSA + Skyway worst 16:30-20:00 Mon-Fri. Allow 60-75min Makati→NAIA Mon 01 Jun PM departure.
Tagaytay traffic Sat
Tagaytay weekend traffic adds 30-60min each way. Leave Makati by 07:00 OR delay to Mon (skip flight day).
Quiapo pickpockets
Plaza Miranda crowded — wear money belt, no flashy phone, leave passport at hotel.
Day 2 fatigue (v1)
Binondo food crawl + Quiapo + Escolta + Poblacion crawl = high; v2 cuts Quiapo + crawl optional.
Pinatubo flood risk
Early-season tropical depressions possible; monitor PAGASA for LPA 1 week pre-trip.
Taal volcano alert
Day-trip to Tagaytay rim viewpoint OK at Alert Level 1-2; crater boat ride NOT allowed >Level 2. Check PHIVOLCS.
NAIA terminal mix-up
PH airlines split T2/T3/T4. PAL=T2, Cebu Pacific=T3 (intl/domestic mixed). Confirm terminal on booking — wrong terminal = miss flight.
Currency cash
Many small eateries + jeepneys cash-only. GCash accepted in Makati/BGC but spotty in Binondo/Quiapo. Carry ₱2-3k cash daily.
Pollution/heat
Heat index can hit 42°C midday late May. Indoor break 12:00-15:00; hydrate.

transport_tips: Grab >> regular taxi. Predictable fare, no haggling, GCash payment. Surge during rain — wait 5min.
EDSA traffic worst Mon-Fri 16:30-20:00 and Sun 19:00-22:00 (return-to-city). Plan around.
Jeepney for adventure only — minimal English, ₱13-20 fixed. Don't try with luggage.
Metro Manila Skyway costs ₱65-200 toll — Grab driver may ask cash for toll; OK to add to fare.
NAIA inter-terminal shuttle is FREE — pink bus loops T1↔T2↔T3↔T4 every 15 min.
Tagaytay private car ₱3,500-4,500 RT; avoid Sat morning outbound traffic by leaving by 07:00.
P2P bus to Tagaytay (DLTB/Genesis) ₱250 from Cubao or PITX — slow but cheap.
accommodation_recommendation: RECOMMENDATION: Single hotel in Makati CBD (walking distance to Greenbelt + Poblacion + Salcedo). Citadines Salcedo = sweet spot mid-range. Book Free Cancellation rate to allow late pivot to BGC if needed. Avoid Manila/Ermita budget hotels (further from BGC, worse safety after dark).

places.name: Intramuros (Walled City)
places.description: 16th-century Spanish walled city — the historic core of colonial Manila. Contains Fort Santiago (Rizal's last prison), San Agustin Church (1607, UNESCO, oldest stone church in PH), Manila Cathedral, Casa Manila, Bahay Tsinoy. Best explored on foot or by bamboo bike (Bambike eco-tours ₱1,200). Allocate half a day minimum.

places.name: Rizal Park (Luneta)
places.description: Largest urban park in PH and site of national hero José Rizal's execution (1896). Houses Rizal Monument (24/7 honor guard), Chinese & Japanese gardens, National Museum complex nearby. Free entry. Best at sunrise or late afternoon to avoid heat.

places.name: National Museum Complex
places.description: Three free museums — Fine Arts (Spoliarium by Luna), Anthropology, Natural History (Lolong the croc). FREE admission since 2016. AC, 3-4 hr comfortable visit. Closed Mondays.

places.name: Binondo (Chinatown)
places.description: World's oldest Chinatown (established 1594). Food crawl heaven — Eng Bee Tin (hopia), Wai Ying (dimsum), Sincerity Cafe (kiampong + fried chicken), Lord Stow's (egg tart), Polland (pork siopao). Old Manila Walks 'Big Binondo Food Wok' tour ₱1,500.

places.name: Quiapo Church (Minor Basilica of the Black Nazarene)
places.description: Home of the Black Nazarene — focal point of one of the largest Catholic devotions in Asia (Traslación every Jan 9). Surrounding Quiapo: Hidalgo St photography row, Raon St electronics, Villalobos herb stalls. Watch pickpockets in crowded plaza.

places.name: Manila Cathedral
places.description: Minor Basilica and seat of the Archbishop of Manila. Current (8th) structure consecrated 1958 after WWII destruction. Free entry outside Mass times. Stained glass, papal organ. Pair with San Agustin walk.

places.name: San Agustin Church
places.description: Oldest stone church in the Philippines (1607). UNESCO World Heritage. Survived 7 earthquakes + WWII bombing of Intramuros. Adjacent museum has religious art and relics. Entry ₱200.

places.name: Ayala Museum
places.description: Reopened 2022 with stunning Gold of Ancestors gallery (precolonial gold artifacts, world-class), Diorama Experience (60+ scenes of PH history), and rotating contemporary exhibits. Entry ₱650. Allocate 2-3 hours.

places.name: Bonifacio Global City (BGC)
places.description: Modern CBD with Bonifacio High Street (pedestrian zone), Mind Museum, The Alley at Karrivin Plaza (art galleries), and the BGC street-art trail. Best for upscale shopping + dining. Walkable.

places.name: Manila Baywalk + Sunset
places.description: Famous Manila Bay sunset stretch along Roxas Blvd. Free. Best 17:30-18:30. Newly rehabilitated 'White Beach' near US Embassy. Skip if tide low (smell). Pair with dinner at CCP/Aristocrat.

places.name: Tagaytay (Taal Volcano view)
places.description: Cool-climate ridge city overlooking Taal Volcano. 1.5-2hr drive from Makati. Bulalo (bone-marrow beef stew) at Leslie's or Diner's. Sky Ranch amusement park. People's Park in the Sky for volcano panorama. Sonya's Garden for organic lunch. Easy day trip.

places.name: Corregidor Island
places.description: WWII tadpole-shaped island fortress at Manila Bay entrance. Sun Cruises ferry from ESPLANADE Seaside Terminal (CCP). Malinta Tunnel, Pacific War Memorial, Mile-Long Barracks, Battery Way. Full-day tour 06:30-15:30. ~₱2,999/pax incl ferry+lunch+tram.

places.name: Escolta Street
places.description: Once Manila's Wall Street — now a heritage art district. First Saturday Block Party (Saturdays of the month). Calvo Building, Regina Building, Capitol Theatre ruins. HUB:Make Lab for indie design. Often missed by tourists.

places.name: Poblacion (Makati nightlife district)
places.description: Gritty-cool district reinvented as Manila's premier bar/food crawl zone. Rooftop bars (Z Hostel), speakeasies (Run Rabbit Run), Korean BBQ row, late-night taco stands. Walkable from Makati CBD hotels.

places.name: Pinto Art Museum (Antipolo)
places.description: Whitewashed Mediterranean-style contemporary art compound on a hill in Antipolo. Multiple galleries + gardens + cafe. Phenomenal Instagram spot but actually substantive curation. ₱250. Worth the Grab ride.

places.name: Manila Chinese Cemetery
places.description: Surreal 'mini-city' cemetery where mausoleums have AC, mailboxes, two-storey houses. Built when Chinese were denied burial in Catholic cemeteries during Spanish era. Free, hire pedicab guide (~₱500) at gate.

places.name: Wai Ying Fastfood
places.description: Cheap, fast Cantonese dimsum + hakaw + soy chicken. Cult favorite. Two branches (Benavidez + Salazar). Cash only.

places.name: Manam Comfort Filipino
places.description: Modern Filipino tapas — sinigang sa watermelon, crispy pata, kare-kare. Order classics + twist sides. Walk-ins okay weekday lunch.

places.name: Toyo Eatery
places.description: Asia's 50 Best — pinakbet bukid, Filipino tasting menu. Splurge dinner.

places.name: Aristocrat Restaurant (Roxas Blvd)
places.description: Manila institution since 1936. Famous chicken BBQ + java rice + atchara. Heritage feel, often packed Sundays after Mass.

places.name: Romulo Café
places.description: Heritage Filipino — Tito Greg's adobo flakes, chicken relleno, dinuguan empanadas. Named after Carlos P. Romulo. Good for groups.

places.name: Sentro 1771
places.description: Modern Filipino — corned-beef sinigang (iconic), bagnet, ensaladang mangga. Solid sit-down option.

places.name: Leslie's Restaurant Tagaytay
places.description: Classic bulalo (beef bone-marrow stew) with Taal Lake panorama. Tourist mainstay but worth it for the view + the broth.

places.name: Wildflour Café + Bakery
places.description: Upscale all-day café — eggs benedict, salted caramel ensaymada, fresh pastries. Reliable any day.

places.name: The Spa (Fort Bonifacio)
places.description: Reliable mid-range chain — Swedish, hilot, hot stone. Couples rooms. Book ahead Sat/Sun.

places.name: Nuat Thai
places.description: Cheap reliable Thai massage chain. Walk-in possible. Foot reflex highly recommended after Intramuros walking day.

places.name: Devarana Spa (Dusit Thani)
places.description: Luxury hotel spa, Thai-inspired rituals, signature Devarana 150min package. Best splurge.

places.name: Mandala Spa (Antipolo)
places.description: Hidden hillside spa retreat. Pair with Pinto Art Museum for half-day off-radar wellness combo.

places.name: Z Hostel Rooftop Bar
places.description: Open-air rooftop bar — sunset cocktails, Manila skyline view. Crowd builds 21:00 onward.

places.name: The Curator
places.description: Speakeasy behind coffee shop. World's 50 Best Bars alum. Craft cocktails. Reservation recommended Fri/Sat.

places.name: Run Rabbit Run
places.description: Speakeasy behind grocery façade. Cocktails + small plates. Hidden door experience.

places.name: The Bank Bar
places.description: Concealed inside RCBC Plaza — enter via Ze Royal Filipino-Cuban restaurant. Classic cocktail focus.

places.name: Sky Deck Bayleaf
places.description: Rooftop bar atop Bayleaf — Intramuros + Manila Bay views. Less crowded than Poblacion.

hotels.name: Red Planet Makati (Mabini)
hotels.notes: Walking distance Poblacion + Greenbelt. Clean, no-frills. Best budget pick.

hotels.name: Citadines Salcedo Makati
hotels.notes: Aparthotel with kitchen, gym, pool. Salcedo Village near Saturday market. Mid-range sweet spot.

hotels.name: Dusit Thani Manila
hotels.notes: Across Ayala MRT, walking to Greenbelt/Ayala Museum. Devarana Spa onsite. Reliable luxury.

hotels.name: Shangri-La The Fort (BGC)
hotels.notes: If staying BGC instead of Makati. Tallest hotel in PH. Samba rooftop bar, CHI Spa.

booking_flex_tips.label: Klook bookings
booking_flex_tips.text: Filter 'Free cancellation up to 24hr' — most Tagaytay + Corregidor + Pinto tours offer it. Decide outdoor activities 2 days out based on PAGASA radar.

booking_flex_tips.label: Hotel rate
booking_flex_tips.text: Agoda / Booking Free Cancellation rate (~5-10% more than non-refund) lets you extend a day at fixed rate if flight cancels.

booking_flex_tips.label: Cebu Pacific / PAL flights
booking_flex_tips.text: Both waive change fees during officially-declared typhoon advisories. Monitor T-72hr via carrier app + Twitter (@CebuPacificAir / @flyPAL). Domestic = waived less generously than intl — file early.

booking_flex_tips.label: Travel insurance
booking_flex_tips.text: Standard Insurance, Pioneer, Malayan PH all cover >6hr delay (meals, hotel, transit) + cancellation. Keep receipts; file within 30 days.

booking_flex_tips.label: Private driver
booking_flex_tips.text: Hotel-arranged Tagaytay car can reschedule same week. Klook private = refund if road impassable. Confirm by 18:00 day before.

booking_flex_tips.label: Spa bookings
booking_flex_tips.text: WhatsApp The Spa BGC / Nuat Thai — flexible to reshuffle same week. No deposit at most chains.

booking_flex_tips.label: Forecast sources
booking_flex_tips.text: PAGASA (pagasa.dost.gov.ph official PH), Windy.com (radar + multi-model), AccuWeather (hour-by-hour), Yr.no (Norwegian Met = often more accurate).

booking_flex_tips.label: Local cue
booking_flex_tips.text: If hotel staff says 'malakas ang ulan' (heavy rain) or 'bagyo' (typhoon) — believe them over app forecasts. Check PHIVOLCS for Taal alert.

booking_flex_tips.label: Flood signals
booking_flex_tips.text: MMDA Flood Twitter (@MMDA) reports street-level flooding live. España Blvd + EDSA Cubao + Marikina = first to flood.

activity_pricing.category: 🚌 TAGAYTAY DAY TRIP — PICK ONE BUNDLE

paths.name: PATH 1 — Klook GROUP DAY TOUR
paths.includes: ALL-IN: RT van + Picnic Grove + Sky Ranch entry + bulalo lunch + Sonya's. Group of 10-15. Cheapest path.

paths.name: PATH 2 — Private Grab car RT
paths.includes: Private car + driver RT (8hr). Entries + lunch NOT incl. Most flexible.

paths.name: PATH 3 — Self-drive rental
paths.includes: Self-drive small SUV 24hr + fuel + toll. NLEX-CAVITEX. Independence; need PH license.

paths.name: PATH 4 — DIY by P2P bus
paths.channel: DLTB / Genesis bus from Cubao or PITX
paths.includes: BUS ONLY one-way. Cheap, slow. Add jeepney/tricycle at Tagaytay. For backpackers.

extras.name: Optional: People's Park in the Sky entry
Optional: Taal Lake boat to volcano crater
extras.includes: Bangka boat + island fee. Check PHIVOLCS volcano alert level FIRST.

activity_pricing.category: 🏝️ CORREGIDOR DAY TRIP — PICK ONE BUNDLE

paths.name: PATH 1 — Sun Cruises full-day
paths.includes: RT ferry from ESPLANADE + tram tour + buffet lunch + guide. 06:30-15:30. Only practical path.

paths.name: PATH 2 — Overnight Corregidor
paths.includes: Tour + Corregidor Inn 1 night + meals. Sunset + lights-of-Manila view.

paths.name: PATH 1 — Self-walk + entries
paths.includes: Fort Santiago ₱75 + San Agustin ₱200 + Casa Manila ₱75. Walk between. Cheapest.

paths.name: PATH 2 — Bambike Eco-Tour
paths.includes: Bamboo bike + guide + all entries 2.5hr. Most fun moderate-cost option.

paths.name: PATH 3 — Kalesa carriage hire
paths.includes: 1hr horse-drawn carriage tour. Tourist-y but classic. NEGOTIATE before boarding.
